# Position sizing

## The answer
Risk a fixed small slice of the account per trade and size the contract count from the stop distance. ([[Notes/module-2/lesson-2.3|2.3]])

## How it works

### Fixed risk slice
- Pick a dollar risk first, then divide by the stop distance. ([[Notes/module-2/lesson-2.3|2.3]])

### Scaling up
- Add size only after a run of steady weeks. ([[Notes/module-2/lesson-2.3|2.3]])

## Where lessons disagree
- None.

## Small-account and 0DTE notes
- On a small account one contract may already exceed the risk slice; then skip the trade.

## What the course doesn't cover
- Nothing on margin accounts.
